Scaled number -0.05 against a findings sum of -0.1: the two agree, and both say near zero.

findings.finding: The TOB at 2,970 yen closed on 2026-10-05 with 10,365,448 shares tendered; founders sell in parallel and Bain reaches 85.68% of votes on 2026-10-13. Since that is below 90%, it squeezes out by share consolidation at an EGM in mid-December (record date 2026-10-16), with the payout set equal to 2,970 yen times shares held. The spot is 3,015, about 1.5% above that cash. Q2 results cannot change the payout, so the move is the arb premium drifting, and it leans slightly back toward 2,970.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the TOB the stock has closed between 2,940 and 2,985 (2026-08-24 to 2026-10-14, Yahoo daily bars), and the one move over 1% was +1.1% on 2026-10-06, the day the result was announced. The baseline's 6.81% median earnings reaction comes from before the MBO and does not apply.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the tape is pinned near 2,970 and the 0.44% one-day vol says so. What is left is the 1.5% premium above the payout, which buyers paid up to 3,065 this morning. If the market were treating Q2 as a real earnings event, the baseline's 6.81% proxy would show up as option-like dispersion around the release. It does not: the stock moves only on arb flow.
findings.independence: The EGM record-date notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20261001/140120261001544586.pdf, 2026-10-01) and the MBO notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260819/140120260817521803.pdf; it states the consolidation payout equals the TOB price times shares held) are separate documents from the same issuer and agree.

findings.finding: Q1 FY27 (Mar-May 2026) operating profit was 846 mn yen, 19.2% of the 4,409 FY plan, against 17.9% of the prior year's actual at Q1. A strong H1 can only matter here by feeding speculation on appraisal (価格決定申立て) or a higher squeeze-out value, since the 2,970 price carried a premium the board itself called below comparable cases.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not applicable since the MBO. Before it the stock moved -3.4% after Q1 (baseline estimated cadence, 2026-07-16).
findings.why_not_priced: Appraisal value is decided by a court over years, outside the window, so a good print shifts only the odds arbs put on it. That is a small transmission: the premium over 2,970 is already 1.5%, and it would be wider if holders saw a real chance of a higher payout.
findings.independence: The MBO notice concedes the premium 'is not necessarily high compared with similar cases' (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260819/140120260817521803.pdf, item (g)). That is a different document, but the inference is mine.

outside_window.finding: EGM for the share consolidation in mid-December 2026, then delisting. Any appraisal petition (価格決定申立て) by holdouts resolves well after that.

baseline_tension: Agrees with the baseline: a flat 5-day and 20-day run-up, zero shorts and a near-zero lean are what a pinned arb stock looks like. The strongest positive the release could carry is a strong H1 feeding hopes of a higher squeeze-out or appraisal value, and today's spike to 3,065 shows some buyers paying for that. I looked, found no activist filing, and that is why p_up is held at 47 rather than lower.
